reason: With more than six staff we would have to pay ₹4,999 a month for the Pro tier, which is nearly ten times what Jamku charges annually. Even though sovereign Google Drive storage addresses my confidentiality concerns, the steep price premium makes it impossible to justify buying upfront.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive, especially for a firm that exceeds five seats?
would_change_my_mind: A mid-firm annual tier priced under ₹20,000 for up to 15 seats, plus verifiable proof that Docketra cannot read our confidential client files.
